L112: ### Abstract
L113: We detect jumps in a high-frequency price series of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that track the broad indexes of U.S. equity markets. Although many jumps (43%) are related to macroeconomic news, more jumps (57%) are not. No-news jumps are followed by significant return reversals for at least 60 minutes. The return dynamics after news-related jumps vary with the news characteristics. Scheduled-news jumps are followed by reversals, whereas unscheduled-news jumps are followed by momentum.
L114: Whether related to news or not, negative jumps are followed by stronger return reversals than are positive jumps.
